subject: [PATCH v1] btrfs: add LOGICAL_INO_V2 flag for avoiding the tree modification log

reviews.author: Qu Wenruo
reviews.summary: Reviewer Qu Wenruo found the patch acceptable and provided a Reviewed-by tag, indicating no major issues or concerns.
reviews.raw_body:
The idea looks good to me.

Reviewed-by: Qu Wenruo <wqu@suse.com>

Thanks,
Qu

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch adds a new flag, LOGICAL_INO_V2, to the Btrfs file system that allows userspace to avoid enabling the tree modification log during backref walks. This is useful for applications like Meta's space usage estimation tool, which can tolerate slightly stale results and doesn't need the full accuracy of the tree modification log. The patch introduces a new ioctl argument, BTRFS_LOGICAL_INO_ARGS_COMMIT_ROOT, that enables this behavior by making the walk use commit roots instead of current trees. This reduces the overhead on the file system during transactions and allows userspace to choose between accuracy and performance.

reviews.author: Zygo Blaxell
reviews.summary: Reviewer Zygo Blaxell noted that the patch improves performance for the same use case as btdu and bees, which also benefits from disabling the tree modification log.
reviews.raw_body:
I was about to send the same patch after tracking down some performance
issues.  This is the same use case as btdu, and bees goes a lot faster
without the tree mod log as well.  Much appreciated!
